name: cTSEffectsResourceFactory::cTSEffectsResourceFactory
notes: Lane IT. Standalone shape (src/ts/cTSEffectsResourceFactory.h: our class derives from cIGZPersistResourceFactory; 0x10 bytes, cGZPersistResourceFactory's layout; slots 0-6 run cGZPersistResourceFactory's members (ours, old shape) on the object, slot 8 the shared body 0x1f62f0 is ours in our vtable, unhooked). Hooked through the Construct adapter: cTSEffectsManager::Init (0xbc8fa0, still the original) makes a factory with inline new plus this constructor, Create 0xbd2ff0 is hooked too, so every factory carries our vtable. EffectsResourceFactory_Slots builds each side on the same garbage-filled block (mode 0 the original constructor and the RVAs, 1 ours through our vtable, 2 the adapters), runs random slot operations (slot 9 with resource types and interface ids, slots 10 / 11 on a fake effects resource and record, slots 3 / 8 creating, reading and asking a real resource from a fake record and stream, the base's slots 0-2 and 5 / 6) and compares results, the fakes' call logs and the factory's count and lock after each. Mutants build/it_mut_fac.log (17 over the class: 15 killed; 2 equivalent: slot 8 passing a5 = 1 and slot 3 passing a4 for a5 only change whether the base's CreateInstance goes through slot 4 or slot 9, and this class's slot 4 is the base's forwarder to slot 9 with the same arguments).

name: cTSEffectsResourceFactory::~cTSEffectsResourceFactory
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the Destruct adapter (11 bytes): the lock destroyed. EffectsResourceFactory_Slots ends two seeds in three with it (the lock block's free compared).

name: cTSEffectsResourceFactory scalar deleting destructor (slot 7)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the DeletingDestructor adapter. EffectsResourceFactory_Slots: flags 0 on the block (one seed in three), flags 1 through the heap path's last Release (the base's Release calls slot 7) or the adapter directly.

name: cTSEffectsResourceFactory::Create (cdecl, registered by the cTSEffectsCOMDirector constructor)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked to cTSEffectsResourceFactory::Create (new 0x10, null on failure). EffectsResourceFactory_Slots' heap path: the original's Create against ours, counted, released to deletion; the frees compared.

name: cTSEffectsResourceFactory::CreateResource (slot 9: type, riid, out)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the CreateResource adapter. Makes our cTSEffectsResource (Create, ours) for type 0xea5118b0, counted while asked for riid. EffectsResourceFactory_Slots op 0 (types right and wrong, five interface ids; the face handed out, the class id, the releases) and op 3 (through the base's CreateInstance).

name: cTSEffectsResourceFactory::ReadRecord (slot 10: resource, serial record)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the ReadRecord adapter: the key type checked, the record's cIGZIStream (0x51b11bd), the resource's Read (slot 7 of the +0 face, from the persist face - 0x78), the stream released. EffectsResourceFactory_Slots ops 1 (fake resource: type right or wrong, stream or none, result bytes other than 0 / 1) and 3 / 4 (through the base's CreateInstance and Read, on a real resource and fake stream).

name: cTSEffectsResourceFactory::WriteRecord (slot 11: resource, serial record)
notes: Lane IT. Hooked through the WriteRecord adapter: as 0xbd4030 with cIGZOStream (0xc51b11cb) and the resource's Write (slot 6). EffectsResourceFactory_Slots ops 2 and 4 (through the base's Write).
